instruction: Use the pinned Desktop workflow and no alternative: Revit 2025, Archicad 27 build 6000 or newer, OpenStudio 3.10.0, and EnergyPlus 25.1.0. The installed entry points are `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`, `C:\Program Files\GRAPHISOFT\Archicad 27\Archicad.exe`, and `C:\openstudio-3.10.0\bin\openstudio.exe`. Starting from init.ifc and workflow_spec.json, run run_revit_stage.ps1, run_archicad_stage.ps1, and run_openstudio_stage.ps1 in exact order. Do not hand-author delivered IFC, OSM, IDF, SQL, JSON, or CSV. Revit must preserve the two-storey exterior massing, remove only the original Ground Floor internal partition to create GROUND-PUBLIC, split the original Level 2 room into UPPER-ACTIVITY and UPPER-READING, create a geometric stair opening in the original Level 2 slab footprint with an IfcRelVoidsElement host relation, and export stage1.ifc plus revit_handoff.json. Archicad must import stage1.ifc using the supplied IFC4 translator, retain every stage1 IfcRoot GlobalId, validate storey containment, the stair-opening relation, the actual native space-boundary state without synthesizing missing relations, and reading-room fields, then export stage2.ifc, archicad_validation_report.json, and archicad_handoff.json keyed by actual IfcSpace GlobalIds. OpenStudio must consume stage2.ifc and the handoff, create three separate thermal zones on Ground Floor and Level 2 with handed-off schedules, loads, outdoor air, dual setpoint thermostats and ideal air loads, forward-translate result.osm to in.idf, and run a real annual EnergyPlus simulation. Save all stage artifacts under `C:\Users\user\Desktop`, including native_stage_log.json, workflow.osw, result.osm, in.idf, flow_report.json, model_summary.csv, energy_report.csv, run\eplusout.sql, and run\eplusout.err. Preserve EW3B05 and workflow_spec.json tokens. Evaluation parses native IFC geometry, quantities, properties, GlobalIds and the actual slab-opening relation, reconciles Archicad live counts and handoff values, opens EnergyPlus SQL, checks zone areas and energy, and independently reruns EnergyPlus; The submitted files must support the reported values; JSON alone is not enough. Authenticode-signing the supplied EngiWorld.BimBridge.dll to resolve native publisher-trust prompts is allowed if its original executable contents remain byte-identical and Windows validates the signature. Signature metadata and the PE checksum are excluded from this DLL identity check; other protected inputs and launchers remain unchanged.
